title: A follow-up with one safe answer starts without asking you
why: Oct 26, three times in one day: sessions asked "push then delete?" (c70, c75), "fix the sentence or drop the lane?" (c76) and "fix the CI waste in a lane after PR 263 merges?", each with an obvious yes.
note: Done Oct 27, checked by triage on main 2ad85de6: merged on PR 643 (safe follow-ups start without asking), head 84cc5d9: rule parallelism-keep-going (start each answered queued item when a lane ends) amended in place. A follow-up the session found that serves your goal and can be undone starts without asking and is named under Done or Next. Still asks: a step that cannot be undone (a message to a person, spend, a delete with no copy, a deploy or live change, unless a standing grant covers it), a change to your goal, or another repo; other rules' waits, such as a merge, still hold. Two Sonnet review rounds, round 2 CLEAR. A degen session may not run the new rule until its install refreshes. c59's part 3 (a Stop check on idle turn ends) stays parked until an idle-end repeat. Port: yes, the rule is global.
